mintAuthority.summary: yoUSD is an ERC-4626 strategy-vault variant with three independently issued local share deployments on Base, Ethereum, and Arbitrum. USDC issuance is inherited from Circle on each chain, while yoUSD shares are created through user deposit/mint entrypoints with no current privileged mint capability. The chain-local RolesAuthority governs strategy execution, redemption fulfilment, and pause; the 4-of-6 Safe proposes a 2-day TimelockController upgrade path that can replace local mint logic, so the mint-scoped posture is none-resolved-mint with a raiseable upgrade path.

controls.label: yoUSD Base admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Base block 52024964 on 2026-10-01, the Safe has six owners including replacement signer 0xd770a384b34169f4683deed78e2961cba1e22cd3, threshold four, empty module pagination, zero guard, fallback handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99, and VERSION 1.4.1. ProxyAdmin owner and 172800-second timelock remain unchanged.

controls.label: yoUSD Base authority contract
controls.evidence: At base block 52024964 on 2026-10-01, vault authority() returned this Safe-owned RolesAuthority. getRolesWithCapability and isCapabilityPublic returned zero for mint(uint256,address) and deposit(uint256,address). Current implementation 0xc84a6e01bff58996540f1abc22355a9dfe0d78dc exposes public deposit/mint and privileged strategy, pause and redemption-fulfilment functions.

controls.label: yoUSD Base ERC-4626 vault (share mint on deposit)
controls.evidence: At base block 52024964 on 2026-10-01, the proxy implementation is 0xc84a6e01bff58996540f1abc22355a9dfe0d78dc. Verified YoVault source implements public deposit/mint through ERC4626 with pause checks; the RolesAuthority returned zero mint/deposit role bitmaps and false public capability flags. Shares remain deposit-driven, with privileged oracle pricing and a mutable implementation.

review.evidence: Pinned 2026-10-01 census: Base 52024964, Ethereum 26095939, Arbitrum 510590098. All three proxies now use implementation 0xc84a6e01bff58996540f1abc22355a9dfe0d78dc. Local USDC assets, Safe ownership, RolesAuthority and ProxyAdmin/timelock paths match the earlier review; six Safe owners and threshold four remain, but signer 0xd42ec163464da30a6116499254816c9b8da9f87b was replaced by 0xd770a384b34169f4683deed78e2961cba1e22cd3. Mint/deposit capability bitmaps remain zero and verified source retains public asset-funded ERC4626 share creation. Current implementation uses YoOracle for share conversions and privileged operators can settle queued withdrawals at a lower current oracle price. All three Safes have empty module pagination, zero guard, fallback handler 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99, and VERSION 1.4.1.
